text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to the racetrack with Verxina.
However, it wasn't to run. As for why—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, it's done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An art contest is being held
for the students of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
I believe this piece has turned out quite fitting for our theme, "Racing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Depicted on it was a dynamic painting of Verxina dashing across the finish line in first place.
choice_data_list: Looks like we've got a real shot at the grand prize!
Looks like we've got a real shot at the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The supplementary prize is an exhibition in the racecourse museum.
It will be a wonderful opportunity
for the 'races' I cherish to be honored.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That, too, is proof of being at the summit.
...Now then, let us go submit our paintings.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah, here it is. The reception desk is—...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This drawing... the level of detail is incredible...!
Even the Umamusumes' expressions are so intricate—

That painting represents the future I champion.
A vague image simply will not do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Toward an ideal where successors admire us and new stars are born.
That is what 'racing' means to me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san...!
You can see things so clearly, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This painting is no different
from capturing none of my "race" at all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What is the pinnacle to me?
Something far nobler...! Far more profound...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
From flowing hair to every crease in the clothing!
I'll depict the 'race' that reaches the pinnacle!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Alright. This time for sure, I'll submit this drawing—
Alright! Done!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: !? Wh-What an incredible painting...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're someone who knows their stuff.
That's right, this isn't just any ordinary flame.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It speaks straight to my heart...!
The heat of fierce competition—truly a "race"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A painting is a one-on-one duel with the viewer.
Looks like I won the bout against you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I... will not give up on the pinnacle.
Excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
More, even more passion!
The fighting spirit befitting someone standing at the pinnacle...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I'll put everything into this brush!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant* *pant*... W-With this, the registration is...!
—Whoa, what intense power...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
! Fufu, thank you very much.
I poured all of who I am right now into it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I can truly feel their determination
to seize victory. I also—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"‘Shining on the stage of my dreams.’
I worked hard on it because I wanted to express that feeling.
I wanted to give form to the feelings unique to me."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
!? What a unique use of color...
And is this... collage made from colored paper...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Not yet, nowhere near enough... Nowhere neeeear enough!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Not just the motif of the art... but the art supplies too...
I'm going to be utterly uncompromising with everything!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Verxina made a final push for the grand prize—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Is it... done?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There stood a painting nothing short of breathtaking.
A masterpiece was born, radiating pure "tenacity."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh no, look at the time!
But...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Did I really give it everything...? Is there still something... I'm missing...?
choice_data_list: Let's push through to the very end! I'll keep track of the time!
Let's push through to the very end! I'll keep track of the time!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Did I really give it everything...? Is there still something... I'm missing...?
choice_data_list: Let's push through to the very end! I'll keep track of the time!
Let's push through to the very end! I'll keep track of the time!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Verxina didn't give up until the very end and finished her painting—

text_block_list.name: Contest Organizer
text_block_list.text:
We will now announce the results of the contest.
The winner of the Grand Prize is—

text_block_list.name: Contest Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san's "Indomitable Queen"!
The powerful sight of her back heading into the race was magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Contest Organizer
text_block_list.text:
A masterpiece with heart and soul poured into every stroke!
Now, could you share a few words on receiving the award?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Out of so many masterpieces, I thank you
for choosing mine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: It's precisely because of those masterpieces that I am standing here today.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I learned it from all of you.
That there are even greater heights to reach.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I was able to soar.
—To this very pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having clinched the award for Best in Show,
Verxina proudly accepted the praise!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To think there are four top prize winners.
I suppose it just goes to show how close the competition was, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"There is only room for one at the top.
I will continue to strive for even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I lost my composure there, didn't I?
Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I gave everything I have right now.
Even if I'm not chosen... I have no regrets."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result—she received the Special Jury Award in the contest.
Even so, Verxina did not look down.
With her head held high, she accepted the certificate!
